name: iter_mix_rate
description: MIX RATE - how HARD should the rehearsal mix be dumped after round 1? Companion to iter_mix_adaptation: the two decaying schedules at starting mix 1.0, with the decay rate at its extremes. Exponential rate 0.1 is the sharpest front-load expressible (alpha 1.0 -> 0.1 -> 0.01: effectively 'guided round 1, random thereafter'), so it directly measures how much of the guided advantage lives in round 1 alone. Linear rate 1.0 reaches alpha=0 exactly at the final iteration. Read together with iter_mix_adaptation's rate-0.5 rows. New-only regime, warm-start, 10 seeds.
